newsitem.title: USA: Incomnet says court okays settlement.
newsitem.headline: Incomnet says court okays settlement.

text.p: Incomnet Inc Thursday said U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York has given final approval to a legal settlement between the company and its former president, Sam Schwartz.
Under the final agreement, Schwartz will pay the company cash and stock valued at $4.25 million. The settlement includes 1,047,966 common shares and $600,000 in cash, Incomnet said in a statement.
The previously announced settlement relates to litigation that began in January 1996 and was filed by a shareholder for the benefit of the company.
Under its agreement with the shareholder, Incomnet is obligated to pay $626,450 in attorneys' fees and expenses.
The shares of stock and cash are presently in escrow and are expected to be delivered within 10 days.
Incomnet is a provider of innovative cost-saving products in the telecommunications and optical lens industries.
